column1: # Draft G09 (subchapter 6.6): server decommission console flow (409 may_confirm_gone=false on live server, 409 may_confirm_gone=true on silent server known by slot, 202 with gone=true, idempotent repeat, DELETE withdrawal)
# Norms: 6.6 Н1 «decommission», Н2.1, Н3 «вывести_сервер(s) — сторона консоли», Н4 (P/06.6-02)
# 1. Live server srv-a: both gone=false and gone=true are rejected with 409 and may_confirm_gone=false
# 2. Server srv-b known via slot testsub/slots/w-1 without resource heartbeat: once slot observation ages past LOST_AFTER (45s), may_confirm_gone becomes true
# 3. Repeated POST /servers/srv-b/decommission returns 202 without overwriting existing platform/decommission/srv-b
# 4. DELETE /servers/srv-b/decommission withdraws the mark and logs server.decommission_withdrawn
